topic.title: 0.950 with a second architecture: Heliosli's S6 ConvNeXt retrained on our labels

comments.content:
Training code is now public. The full training code behind this S6 model, and behind our CoAtNet 0.949/0.945 weights, is now in rsna-knee-s6fall-weights under training_code/, shared under Apache-2.0. It includes the trainer, exact argv, pinned input hashes, training pool and targets, the JEV-blend labels with a script that rebuilds them, and the CoAtNet trainer with its OAI wrapper. No OAI subject data is included; the exact OAI input manifest is available only through NDA Study 3407.

Details and caveats, including that the CoAtNet SWA epochs were ranked on Gold-58: discussion 750180.
